newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Swiss Life (Belgium) to maintain GAN broker network.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Life (Belgium) to maintain GAN broker network.

text.p: Swiss Life's Swiss Life (Belgium) unit said on Wednesday it had bought GAN Belgium because of GAN's brokerage network.
Swiss Life (Belgium) bought GAN Belgium from French insurer GAN last November for 3.5 billion Belgian francs.
"Our strategic goal for GAN was to get to their brokerage network," said Louis Durieux, who takes over from Jean-Pierre Troussel as Swiss Life (Belgium) Director General, on March 1.
"Our strategy is to keep GAN as it is, with its management, its products," Durieux told a news conference.
"We're not going to do any cloning of their products...but that does not mean that we will not be looking for synergies," he said.
He added Swiss Life (Belgium) was currently seeking a new new name for GAN Belgium -- at GAN's own request.
